{{Quote|A Scion I served with had a vision: me, riding a star-ladder with a metal assassin. Together, we would face my greatest test.''"<br />"''How dramatic! Did your friend say what the test was?''"<br />"''No. I killed him right after he said that. Emperor Arcann's orders.|Malforia and [[Z0-0M]]|<ref name="Shroud" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''member''' of the [[Scions of Zakuul]] served the [[Eternal Empire]] with [[Exarch]] [[Malforia]], and had a vision about her climbing a sky-ladder with a metal assassin before facing her greatest test. Right after he said it, he was killed by Malforia under order by Emperor [[Arcann]]. Years later, his prophecy would come true on [[Obus VI]], where Malforia's test turned out to be the vacuum of space, which she did not survive.<ref name="Shroud" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Scion is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''.<ref name="Shroud" />
